title: A grin the child starts, to be spotted
summary: By about 4 months, most children grin on their own to get attention, the milestone sheet says.
body: Here the child opens the exchange. That is a different line from the 2-month reply to someone else's grin. sheet files the self-started grin with the 4-month social items, next to a chuckle that is not yet a full giggle. The agency's bar is most children, not every child, and the sheet is not a screening test. Ages outside this US page are not copied here.

sources.title: Milestones by 4 Months
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US government public domain. Supports 'Smiles on his own to get your attention'. The chuckle is a separate card.
